title: Program for Least Recently Used (LRU) Page Replacement Algorithm
problemStatement: Solve “Program for Least Recently Used (LRU) Page Replacement Algorithm” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Medium/Hard).
intuition: "Program for Least Recently Used (LRU) Page Replacement Algorithm" may admit a greedy choice. Sort by the right key, then take the next safe candidate. Prove exchange argument or cite a known theorem.
